data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003 (school-to-seat rubric) inherits from SRC_005 (typed lease-mismatch program eval): both target identity homogenization mutations under a minimal frozen fixture, but SRC_003 generalises from a single typed code assertion to a coverage-decision rubric. The inherited lineage is refuted if SRC_003's rubric fails to reject the same homogenization mutation SRC_005's program eval catches under the identical fixture, or if SRC_003's counterconditions do not logically subsume SRC_005's synchronous-precondition counterconditions.
